newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech shares rebound but sentiment remains bearish.
newsitem.headline: Czech shares rebound but sentiment remains bearish.

text.p: Czech blue chips rebounded strongly on the Prague Stock Exchange on Wednesday, ending the bourse's three-session decline.
SPT Telecom, CEZ and Komercni Banka -- the PSE's three most-capitalised issues -- all gained ground to push the PX50 index up 5.4 poitns, or 0.98 percent, to 555.9.
Overall, 181 issues rose on the day, while 210 fell and 188 held steady. A total of 794,616 million shares changed hands on turnover of 688.2 million crowns.
The bearish sentiment that has plagued the bourse for several weeks remains, with little new money coming in from abroad to change the PSE's fortunes in the near-term.
"In the short-term, the strengthening will not continue, there's absolutely no reason why the market should change its downward trend," said Radek Vavra of Citicorp Securities in Prague.
He added that poorer than expected macro-economic data in recent weeks, coupled with disappointing company results, have also helped dampen investor interest.
